insert into CHB_BOT_AST_POS (POS_ID, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, POS_DATE, PLAN_ASSET_ID, ASSET_CODE, TOTAL_NUM, ISSUE_AMT, UNINVEST_CASH, POS_NUM, POS_AMT, ISFINAPLAN, ISCHL, WORKFLOW_ID, STATUS, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, DATASOURCE )
#{dto.posId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{dto.issuePartyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.posDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dto.planAssetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.assetCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.totalNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dto.issueAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dto.uninvestCash,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dto.posNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dto.posAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{dto.isfinaplan,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{dto.ischl,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{dto.workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dto.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dto.datasource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

MERGE INTO CHB_BOT_AST_POS CII USING (
SELECT '${item.posId}' POS_ID, '${item.issuePartyId}' ISSUE_PARTY_ID, #{item.posDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}null POS_DATE, '${item.planAssetId}' PLAN_ASSET_ID, '${item.assetCode}' ASSET_CODE, ${item.totalNum}null TOTAL_NUM, ${item.issueAmt}null ISSUE_AMT, ${item.uninvestCash}null UNINVEST_CASH, ${item.posNum}null POS_NUM, ${item.posAmt}null POS_AMT, '${item.isfinaplan}' ISFINAPLAN, '${item.ischl}' ISCHL, '${item.workflowId}' WORKFLOW_ID, '${item.status}' STATUS, '${item.orgCode}' ORG_CODE, '${item.deptCode}' DEPT_CODE, '${item.createUser}' CREATE_USER, '${item.createDept}' CREATE_DEPT , current date CREATE_TIME, '${item.updateUser}' UPDATE_USER, current date UPDATE_TIME, '${item.datasource}' DATASOURCE FROM sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
) TEMP
ON(CII.PLAN_ASSET_ID = TEMP.PLAN_ASSET_ID and CII.ASSET_CODE = TEMP.ASSET_CODE and CII.POS_DATE = TEMP.POS_DATE)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CII.POS_ID = TEMP.POS_ID, CII.ISSUE_PARTY_ID = TEMP.ISSUE_PARTY_ID, CII.TOTAL_NUM = TEMP.TOTAL_NUM, CII.ISSUE_AMT = TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, CII.UNINVEST_CASH = TEMP.UNINVEST_CASH, CII.POS_NUM = TEMP.POS_NUM, CII.POS_AMT = TEMP.POS_AMT, CII.ISFINAPLAN = TEMP.ISFINAPLAN, CII.ISCHL = TEMP.ISCHL, CII.WORKFLOW_ID = TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, CII.STATUS = TEMP.STATUS, CII.ORG_CODE = TEMP.ORG_CODE, CII.DEPT_CODE = TEMP.DEPT_CODE, CII.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, CII.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, CII.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, CII.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, CII.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, CII.DATASOURCE = TEMP.DATASOURCE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (POS_ID, ISSUE_PARTY_ID, POS_DATE, PLAN_ASSET_ID, ASSET_CODE, TOTAL_NUM, ISSUE_AMT, UNINVEST_CASH, POS_NUM, POS_AMT, ISFINAPLAN, ISCHL, WORKFLOW_ID, STATUS, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, DATASOURCE) VALUES( TEMP.POS_ID, TEMP.ISSUE_PARTY_ID, TEMP.POS_DATE, TEMP.PLAN_ASSET_ID, TEMP.ASSET_CODE, TEMP.TOTAL_NUM, TEMP.ISSUE_AMT, TEMP.UNINVEST_CASH, TEMP.POS_NUM, TEMP.POS_AMT, TEMP.ISFINAPLAN, TEMP.ISCHL, TEMP.WORKFLOW_ID, TEMP.STATUS, TEMP.ORG_CODE, TEMP.DEPT_CODE, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME, TEMP.DATASOURCE )
